verdict.rationale: Snyk provides AI-generated insights directly in-product: DeepCode AI-powered risk scoring/prioritization, actionable fix advice, an LLM-driven Remediation Agent that scans, generates fix plans enriched with Snyk security intelligence, applies fixes, and verifies results, plus natural-language querying via MCP/Snyk Studio. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and accuracy (community evidence is largely about unrelated PR/dependency issues, not AI-insight quality), and no data on how these insights surface for non-code data sources beyond code/deps/IaC.
